meta.title: My Girlfriend’s Favorite Jackets (Haul)
meta.description:
Woah look it's my gf Taylor! How nice! How to keep your girlfriend warm? Down jackets? Sherpa jackets? Layers? Not sure!

In this video we are looking at my girlfriend Taylor and her winter jacket collection! What you are seeing is basically all the denim jackets, down jackets, and wool jackets that I gave her (besides her thrifted leather jacket). Which ALSO reminds me that most of the jackets here (and our clothes are thrifted) which I think I'll make a video on next. Actually I'm so glad I wrote this description because I just gave myself a video idea. Great job me! So yeah, I typically use eBay and grilled but Taylor really likes dePop and Poshmark. So whatever floats your boat really.

Jackets:
Levi's Type III Denim Jacket Sherpa lined (from the 80's)
L.L. Bean Baxter State Parka Down Jacket (80's-90's)
Woolrich Arctic Down Parka (80's-90's)
Thrifted Lamb Leather Jacket (???)

The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered.
